scheme_name: Micro Finance Scheme- Credit Line 1 for Minority Community
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to a minority community (Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Buddhists, Parsis, or Jains)
In an SHG, at least 75% of members should be from minority communities (up to 60% allowed in exceptional cases)
Remaining SHG members may be from other weaker sections such as SC, Handicapped, or other minorities
Annual family income must not exceed ₹98,000 in rural areas or ₹1,20,000 in urban areas
Applicant must possess a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID)
benefits_summary: Provides a loan of up to ₹1,00,000 per beneficiary to members of Self‑Help Groups.
